name: 99205 · Spokane, WA
findings: ZIP 99205 (Spokane) has 147 nonprofit organizations. 74 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99205 (Spokane) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
